sources.title: The Nobel Prize — Rabindranath Tagore, Literature 1913

creative_originality.rationale: Produced thousands of poems and songs, novels, plays, and (later in life) paintings — the 1913 Nobel Prize in Literature for Gitanjali is a documented, independently-verified recognition of a specific body of original work.

aesthetic_sensitivity.rationale: The Nobel Prize citation and sustained international critical reception of Gitanjali directly document recognition of his aesthetic craft, not merely his output volume.

cross_domain_range.rationale: Real, sustained output across poetry, prose fiction, musical composition (he composed both India's and Bangladesh's national anthems, a documented, unusual fact), and, from his sixties onward, painting — genuine achievement in each, not dabbling.

independent_thinking.rationale: Publicly renounced his British knighthood in 1919 in protest of the Jallianwala Bagh massacre — a specific, well-documented, high-profile act of dissent against colonial authority.

risk_tolerance.rationale: The same knighthood renunciation carried real social and political risk within the colonial establishment he was a prominent, honored member of.

leadership_drive.rationale: Founded Visva-Bharati University at Santiniketan as an alternative, humanistic educational institution — a documented, sustained institution-building effort beyond his literary work.

proactive_agency.rationale: Self-initiated the founding of Visva-Bharati rather than working within an existing institution, documented via the university's own founding history.

mastery_orientation.rationale: Took up painting seriously as a new art form only in his sixties, well after his literary reputation was fully established, purely from continued creative interest rather than any external need.

experimentation.rationale: The same late-life adoption of painting as an entirely new medium evidences willingness to experiment outside his already-successful domain.

discipline.rationale: Sustained an extraordinarily prolific output across nearly six decades of active writing and composition, evidencing consistent long-term productivity.

persuasiveness.rationale: Conducted extensive international lecture tours as a public intellectual, documented via records of his travels across Europe, the Americas, and East Asia.

social_assertiveness.rationale: The public knighthood renunciation, combined with sustained international public lecturing, evidences real willingness toward public assertion of his views.

conflict_tolerance.rationale: The knighthood renunciation was itself a direct, public confrontation with British colonial authority, documented as a deliberate and consequential choice rather than a private grievance.

curiosity.rationale: Sustained engagement across an unusually wide range of creative and intellectual forms throughout his life evidences genuine exploratory drive beyond what mastery of any single form would require.

adaptability.rationale: Successfully took up an entirely new creative medium (painting) late in life after decades of established success in literature — a genuine, documented instance of adapting to a new domain rather than remaining within an already-proven one.

impact_motivation.rationale: Founded Visva-Bharati specifically as an alternative, humanistic model of education distinct from colonial-era schooling, documented via his own stated educational philosophy — motivation toward broader structural impact, not only personal literary achievement.

deep_focus.rationale: Sustained output at this volume across nearly six decades implies real sustained engagement, though the specific surviving record documents output more than working method in detail.

planning_orientation.rationale: Visva-Bharati's deliberately designed curriculum and campus, built around a specific alternative educational philosophy, evidences real advance planning, though scored moderately given limited detail on his personal day-to-day working habits.

perfectionism.rationale: Documented to have personally, substantially revised his own Bengali poems when self-translating Gitanjali into English rather than producing a literal translation — a specific, corroborated instance of sustained revision toward his own standard.

collaboration.rationale: Visva-Bharati was built as a collaborative artistic and educational community bringing together musicians, artists, and scholars, though the surviving record documents the institution more than his specific personal collaborative behavior within it.

execution_speed.rationale: A documented output of over 2,000 songs and dozens of books and plays across his lifetime evidences a genuinely fast working pace when engaged, beyond what occasional composition would produce.

provenance.notes: First-batch diversity pick: 19th/20th-century-boundary, south_asia (already has Ramanujan/Malala but no literary/philosophical figure), polymath profile distinct from every other candidate in this batch — genuinely wide, well-documented cross-domain range (literature, music, painting, education) rather than a single-domain specialist.
